Hyatt Regency Amritsar — a property-wide brand identity, compendium and four restaurant sub-brands (2017).

One master brand for the hotel, then four distinct dining identities beneath it: Punjab Province (an all-day north-Indian bistro), Scotch Haus (the lounge bar), The White Box (the deli) and Tarteria (the pastry shop) — each with its own logo, palette, menus, signage and uniforms, all governed by a single brand compendium.

Brand identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·19.
